description: White meets 1...e5 with the immediate 2.g3, fianchettoing the king's bishop before committing the knight. Black strikes in the center with ...d5, and after the exchange White builds a solid kingside fianchetto setup. Both sides castle into a maneuvering middlegame where White's bishop on g2 eyes the long diagonal.

lines.description: After 1.c4 e5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2, Black plays the central 3...d5. White exchanges 4.cxd5 Nxd5 and develops 5.Nf3 Nc6. White castles 6.O-O, Black retreats 6...Nb6 to avoid exchanges, and both sides complete development with 7.d3 Be7 8.Nbd2 O-O. A solid, strategic battle looms.
lines.name: King's English — Fianchetto Variation
